build_BFP_conv_refine: build a BFP neck module with conv refinement for balanced feature pyramids in object detection
build_BFP_nonlocal_refine: build a BFP neck module with non_local refinement to gather and refine multi-level features
build_BFP_no_refine: build a BFP neck module without refinement that gathers multi-level features and scatters residuals
review_BFP_forward: review the BFP forward method that gathers multi-level features, refines them, and scatters residuals
test_BFP_gather_scatter: test the BFP module forward pass with multi-level input feature maps and verify output shapes
